about.text: Stracciatella made from buffalo milk: shredded stretched curd mixed with cream.

how.text: The buffalo version is the same pulled-curd cheese as stracciatella, made from the curd of buffalo mozzarella: the stretched curd is shredded and mixed with cream. Buffalo herds and their cheeses are much more common west of the Apennines, in Lazio and Campania. No buffalo-specific temperatures or fat figures were found.
